admission.justification: Keeping implementation in its declared package prevents a second copy of validation rules from diverging in a consumer or command entry point.

applicability: Placement and ownership of behavior under the Python package src/rh_pipeline.
conditions: Name the owning package and module before implementing behavior.
Keep command wiring in cli and domain behavior in the package that owns it.
exclusions: Repository-level scripts and CI are outside the Python package map.

evidence: RH-R01@v1 §5 and system/coding-guidelines.md Core Rule and Package Ownership govern this obligation. README.md:13-25 documents package ownership and src/rh_pipeline/validate/file_size.py realizes the validation owner on RH-R01-A3.

statement: Each responsibility in src/rh_pipeline has one owning package and module.
title: Single-responsibility package ownership under src/rh_pipeline
